        gym_present=True,
        free_wifi_included=True

    city="Lexington",
    cuisine=["Japanese", "Thai"]
)
save_to_cache(key="restaurants", value=restaurants)

    city="Lexington"
)

    hotels=hotels,
    attractions=attractions,

)
save_to_cache(key="nearest_attractions", value=nearest_results)
